name: Differentiable Inverse Rendering
aliases: Inverse Rendering with Differentiable Ray Tracing
Differentiable Inverse Rendering for Joint Reconstruction
definition: A fully differentiable pipeline that infers latent 3D scene parameters (geometry, materials, lighting) from images by optimizing them via gradient backpropagation from rendering losses.
summary: Differentiable Inverse Rendering reconstructs 3D geometry, materials, and lighting from images by backpropagating gradients through a differentiable renderer to jointly optimize scene parameters.
